preferred_source: DBAASP official assay-level export; licensing passes but snapshot and isolation gates remain open

author_release.name: AMP-Designer author repository, available DBAASP-derived sequence file
author_release.labels: Every row is one sequence; no header, strain, MIC, unit, censoring, terminal chemistry, assay or source record IDs. It is not a verified copy of the paper's AMP-MIC training dataset.
author_release.code: AMP-MIC directory contains AMP-MIC.py. Read code is prediction-oriented: Sequence input, dummy label 0, exponentiation 10**out; this cannot reconstruct experimental label units or censoring.
author_release.license: Repository MIT is software/associated documentation licensing. No explicit data-specific grant for the entire multi-source collection was verified. Official upstream DBAASP terms permit use with attribution, but do not repair lost label/provenance fields or establish permissions for other pooled sources.
author_release.overlap: Exact case-sensitive sequence intersection: 197/279 local train rows and 27/41 local dev rows. No test access; no homology check. These counts apply only to this pinned file, not to all current DBAASP or all AMP-Designer training data.

alternative.name: DBAASP official live database, authors of Nucleic Acids Research 49(D1):D288-D297; DOI 10.1093/nar/gkaa991
alternative.terms_observation: Data Access Policy expressly permits access, download, copying, use, adaptation and redistribution and requires source acknowledgement. This is a database data policy, not an inference from article or code licensing.
alternative.version: Official OpenAPI info.version=4.0.1; this is API version, NOT an immutable data release. Source is continuously updated. No dated complete assay snapshot with publisher checksum was verified.
schema_verified: sequence, N/C termini, unusual amino acids, bonds, complexity
medium, CFU, pH, ionic strength, salt, note, reference
alternative.label_evidence_boundary: Official article/help establish experimentally measured activities, strain where available, and assay conditions. The API schema establishes field availability, not actual per-row completeness. Search indexing of peptide8198 reports P. aeruginosa ATCC27853 MIC19.41uM in LBB, but live rendered card was empty and JSON fetch unavailable; not accepted as a verified complete raw sample.
alternative.censoring: Raw activity/concentration are strings; no dedicated universal censoring field in observed schema. Preserve strings, relation (<,<=,>,>=), interval bounds, unit and note. Never coerce inequalities to exact values or NA/unmeasured to inactive. Restrict outcome to MIC, not MBC/IC50/HC50. Retain ambiguous units/strain as excluded-with-reason.
alternative.normalization: For the first eligible subset prefer explicitly named single strain and already-uM measurements. Mass-to-molar conversion only with verified chemical molecular mass including termini/modifications. Do not uppercase D residues into L residues. Match current representation only with verified canonical linear single-chain peptides and resolved terminal chemistry.
alternative.duplicate_and_homology_feasibility: Executable once raw rows are frozen: chemical identity includes sequence, stereochemistry, termini, modifications and bonds. Preserve repeated strain/assay/reference measurements instead of averaging conflicting rows blindly. Group the same sequence across all chemical variants and targets into one split; add similarity clusters and source-paper/family grouping with predeclared alignment/coverage parameters. Current schema supports this, but counts and achieved isolation have not been calculated.
blocking_gates: complete dated immutable assay snapshot, raw response hashes and frozen query/ID inventory absent
raw sample and actual strain/MIC/unit/censoring completeness unverified; eligible N unknown
exact and homology exclusions against train/dev not executed for the live database
sealed-test isolation requires independent custodian; no method-author test access

contamination.AMPGen: The formal AMPGen paper reports a DBAASP MIC dataset (3929 items) used in model development. Common upstream source is therefore established; actual overlap with a future DBAASP subset is not measured. Treat AMPGen MIC scorer as potentially exposed, not an independent validation oracle.
contamination.AMPDesigner: Pinned author file already shares 197 train and27 dev sequences; public availability does not create an untouched holdout.
contamination.existing_H5: Preserve local train/dev hashes and reused-dev status. Future exclusions must cover exact sequences, chemistry variants, homologues and source families across generator, predictor, reward and evaluation data.
contamination.test37: Must be checked only by an independent custodian against a frozen candidate inventory; return exclusion IDs/opaque audit receipt, never sealed sequences or labels to this task.
contamination.wetlab27: Existing27 wetlab measurements must not validate newly generated candidates.

scientific_scope.supported_if_gates_close: A strain- and assay-conditioned MIC prediction/evaluation task, with held-out peptide families, is more biologically informative than Free/Amide sequence statistics. It could supply a property-evaluation basis for an eventual AR generation study.
scientific_scope.not_supported: No verified eligible sample size, independent generation efficacy, method novelty or publication-readiness claim. No new model route or experiment authorized here.
scientific_scope.stop: Two sources inspected; no third-source search, model downloads, training, pooled-data import or new independent-review round.
